docs.text: MotionForge for Maya — User Guide A Maya plug-in that turns one line of text into character motion, moves it onto your own character, and sends it to Cascadeur. It is a port of the MotionForge Blender add-on v0.5.0 to Maya 2027. Every engine runs on your own computer ; nothing is sent over the internet. 한국어: KO_index.md What's new in 0.2.0 Updating from 0.1.0: after installing 0.2.0, press Install Engines in the MotionForge window once. It updates the MotionBricks runtime in your Engine Folder, and the person (SOMA Human) needs it for its model and styles. Check for Updates next to it says what is newer without downloading it. New A person joins MotionBricks - The + in the MotionBricks panel asks for a SOMA Human or the Unitree G1 Robot . The person has the same Style, Go, Speed, Generate Motion , Bake , Live and Retarget as the robot. - A person's 14 styles - idle, walk, slow walk, jog, run, injured, stealth, scared, zombie, happy, boxing, gun, and elbow and hand crawling - come with Install Engines . Make Missing in the Styles box makes any that are missing with Kimodo, and Save as Style adds your own from a baked or generated take. - Install Engines also fetches the person's model (380 MB) with NVIDIA's licence. It runs on the CPU, in a mayapy of its own - no GPU needed. Takes, for the person and the robot - Every character has a list of takes ( + Take / - Take / Show Take ). A take has its own style, direction or target, speed, seed and length, and they are saved with the scene. - The takes run one after the other on one timeline - for example frames 1-30, 31-90, 91-135 - and Generate Motion makes all the ticked ones, each starting where the one before ended. Bake writes them into one animation. Pose to pose - Tick End on Pose Key on a take of a person. Move, turn and pose the character and key it on the frames it should arrive at - say 50 and 100 - and each take is made up to its key, from the pose it starts on. Keys can be 19 to 59 frames apart at 30 fps. - Poses to Use (1 to 4) and Transition Early By let the character flow through its poses without halting. Arrive in a Clip Pose makes a take end in a pose of a style's clip. MMD characters, both ways - With maya_mmd_tools installed, the Retarget panel has an MMD box: Import MMD Model (PMX) and Import MMD Motion (VMD) . - An imported model is a source ( MMD: <name> in the list; its VMD keys are copied like any take) and a target (set Rig Type to MMD model ; Auto-Detect finds one too). Bones are read by their MMD names, so upperarm_L works as well as left_arm . - The legs are switched to FK for the bake, so the leg IK no longer holds them still: the knees stand as keyed from the first frame, the skin's D-bone legs follow, and the IK controllers ride along with the feet. Reset All switches the IK back on. The arm, elbow, hand and neck solvers are left alone. Changed Install Engines now updates too: a runtime file that differs from the published one is replaced, so a newer Kimodo, ARDY or MotionBricks runtime reaches an older install. A style you made or edited is never overwritten. The person's model and ONNX Runtime are shared with the Blender add-on's install, so one Engine Folder serves both. Installation now says exactly how to lay out the folder: rename the unzipped Maya_MotionForge-<version> folder to MotionForge , so MotionForge.mod sits directly inside the folder on MAYA_MODULE_PATH . Fixed MMD target legs. The leg IK used to hold the legs still, bent the knees in the rest pose so the first frame was already folded, and left the skin's D-bone legs reading the idle solver - the body stood stiff while the FK bones moved. An MMD model registered as a group (what Set Selected makes) is recognised as an MMD model. Each take in the Live Path list has its own length. 1. What you need Item Details Maya Maya 2027 (Windows, 64-bit) Engines A MotionForge Engine Folder (ARDY · Kimodo · MotionBricks) — the same folder the Blender add-on uses works GPU ARDY is fast on a GPU (Vulkan); without one it runs on the CPU Cascadeur Optional. Only needed to send motion to Cascadeur or watch it live there 2. Installation 2-1. Register the module (once) The zip holds one folder, Maya_MotionForge-<version> . Unzip it, move that folder somewhere permanent and rename it MotionForge , e.g. C:\Users\<you>\Documents\maya\modules\MotionForge , so that MotionForge.mod sits directly inside it ( ...\MotionForge\MotionForge.mod , not one folder deeper). Keep MotionForge.mod at the root of that folder: it points at the scripts\ and plug-ins\ folders beside it, so copying the .mod on its own will not work. Any folder will do - if your Documents folder is redirected to OneDrive, use the path Explorer shows you. Then put that folder on MAYA_MODULE_PATH , one of two ways: Environment variable : Windows > System Properties > Environment Variables > New user variable MAYA_MODULE_PATH = C:\Users\<you>\Documents\maya\modules\MotionForge . If it already exists, append ;C:\Users\<you>\Documents\maya\modules\MotionForge . Maya.env : add the same line to the Maya.env file of your Maya version (e.g. C:\Users\<you>\Documents\maya\2027\Maya.env ): MAYA_MODULE_PATH = C:\Users\<you>\Documents\maya\modules\MotionForge Restart Maya. 2-2. Load the plug-in In Windows > Settings/Preferences > Plug-in Manager , tick Loaded for MotionForge . Tick Auto load too if you want it every session. A MotionForge menu appears in the menu bar. 2-3. Shelf (optional) Run once in the Script Editor's Python tab: exec ( open ( r "C:\Users\<you>\Documents\maya\modules\MotionForge\scripts\motionforge_shelf.py" ) . read ()) This creates the MotionForge shelf: Load · Window · Connect · Rig · Generate · Kimodo · MB · Retarget · Reload . Running it again does not duplicate the shelf. 3. First-time setup — the Engine Folder Choose the Engine Folder with MotionForge > Set Engine Folder... . Inside it: <Engine Folder>\ ├── ardy\ ARDY (bin\ardy-server.exe, models\*.gguf, assets\cskel27\) ├── kimodo\ Kimodo (generator + text encoder) └── motionbricks\ MotionBricks (DLL + styles) └── soma\ the person: ONNX model, ONNX Runtime, 14 styles MotionForge > Engine Status prints ready (or what is missing) for each engine in the Script Editor. Updating. Install Engines also updates: a runtime file that differs from the published one is replaced, so a newer Kimodo, ARDY or MotionBricks runtime reaches an older install, and the person's styles are fetched with it. Check for Updates (in the window, or MotionForge > Check for Engine Updates ) says what is newer without downloading it, and turns the button into Update Engines when there is something. A style you made or edited is never overwritten. The person's model and ONNX Runtime are shared with the Blender add-on's install, so one Engine Folder serves both. 4. Where things are Where What it does MotionForge menu Open the window, connect/disconnect ARDY, create a rig, one-click generation (ARDY · Kimodo · MotionBricks), retarget, Engine Folder, Engine Status, Install Engines, Install Cascadeur Plug-in, Reload, About Shelf The same one-click entries MotionForge window The full tool. Open MotionForge Window (shelf Window ) docks it on the right; it can be floated or tabbed The window carries Blender's seven panels in the same order, with the same names , and every control works. MotionForge — engines, connection, rigs, HumanIK Text to Motion — takes from text Live Path — steering in real time Kimodo — the Kimodo engine (several characters) MotionBricks — the walking engine (several characters, live, styles) Retarget — onto your own character Send to Cascadeur — to Cascadeur and back Every setting and list in the window (takes, waypoints, pose keys, live takes, Kimodo and MotionBricks characters, the Share list) is saved with the scene and comes back when it is reopened. The line at the top shows what the last button did, or why it failed. 5. Your first animation (5 minutes) MotionForge > Connect ARDY — loads the model (seconds). MotionForge > Create Rig — a 27-joint rig with its body mesh. MotionForge > Generate Motion... — type a person walks forward . The take is keyed and the scene is set to the engine's rate (ARDY: 20 fps) with real-time playback. Play it. The first generation can take a while while the text encoder warms up (about 100 s on this PC); later ones are quick. The window's Generate buttons run in the background , so Maya stays usable; the status line shows progress. 6. The panels 6-1. MotionForge — engines, connection, rigs Control What it does Engines box Each engine's state ( ready or what is missing) and the Engine Folder Set Engine Folder Choose the Engine Folder Install Engines Download the engines (in the background with progress; press again to stop). If this repository carries no engine download manifests it says so — point the Engine Folder at the one the Blender add-on installed Install Cascadeur Plug-in Runs install_mf_maya.bat (asks for Administrator) Connect ARDY / Disconnect Start and stop the ARDY engine (connecting runs in the background). Disconnecting frees GPU memory Skip Text Encoder Connect without the text encoder (no prompts, faster) Ping Whether ARDY answers, and how fast Create Rig / Create Skin A joint rig of the engine's skeleton, with its body mesh HumanIK Character When on, every new rig (ARDY · Kimodo · MotionBricks) is defined as a HumanIK character Generated Rigs / Use Rig The rigs made so far; the picked one becomes the generation target Define as HumanIK Define the selected rig — or your character's joints — as a HumanIK character. A character's joints are read with Retarget's Rig Type Control Rig Build the HumanIK Control Rig (FK/IK controls) mGear (when installed) With mGear (open source, MIT) installed in Maya, a MotionForge character can wear mGear's EPIC biped control rig . Generated takes are keyed onto the mGear controls (FK and IK both), and the character follows the controls, so generated motion is polished like any keyframed animation. Without mGear these buttons are greyed out with the reason shown. Button What it does Build mGear Rig Fits mGear's guide onto the selected character (any joint of it) and builds the rig. A take already on it is baked onto the controls and connected. A 77-joint character gets finger controls too Bake Take to mGear Bakes a new take onto the controls (arms and legs in FK and IK both — switch with arm_blend / leg_blend ) Connect / Disconnect The controls drive the character / the character plays its own keys again Remove Deletes the mGear rig and guide; the character keeps its keys mGear builds one biped per scene. Remove it before rigging another character. With knees and elbows bending as hinges, FK and IK both match the original motion within 0.5 cm. IK poles are placed in the plane the limb actually bends in, frame by frame. 6-2. Text to Motion — takes A take is one generation: its own prompt, length, seed, target rig and path curve. With no takes the panel shows a "Start here" line. Control What it does + / - Add or remove a take. A new take copies the previous one's prompt and length Use Take Put a generated take back on its rig Prompt / Preset What happens. Preset offers example sentences Source Rig The rig this take goes onto; (active source) is the active rig Duration / Seed Length in seconds / -1 differs every time, a number repeats a result Include in Generate All Off leaves the take out of Generate All Continue from the take above Starts where the take above ended Create Curve / Disconnect Curve A path (NURBS curve) for this take alone, or disconnect it. A take with a curve walks the curve instead of the waypoints (facing along it with Face Waypoint Direction) Reduce Foot Skating Foot-skate fix (when off, a warning says waypoints and pose keys will only be approximate) Denoising Steps / Prompt Strength / Constraint Strength Quality and how hard prompt and constraints are followed Generate Take / Generate All (n) The selected take / every enabled take. While generating, Generate All becomes Stop Stream to Unreal / Stream Port Send the finished takes out live (see 6-3) Waypoints — "pass through here on this frame" Turn on Follow Waypoints . Put the time slider on a frame and press + : an MF_Waypoint_01 locator appears (at the selected object or the origin, facing the way the rig faces). Pick one in the list to change its Frame / Enabled . Face Waypoint Direction makes the character face the locator's +Z. Waypoints are read relative to the rig : put the rig in a group and move or turn the group, and it still walks to where they were placed. Pose keys — "hold this pose on this frame" Turn on Use Pose Keys . On the frame you want, press + : a copy of the rig, MF_Pose_001 , appears. Pose Key (shown as Pose once a key is picked) jumps to the key's frame and selects its rig. IK On gives the arms and legs Maya ikHandles (rotate-plane, with pole vectors) to pose by the hands and feet; IK Off keeps the pose in the joints and removes the handles. Pin : Whole Body holds every joint; Parts holds only the hands and feet ticked (LH · RH · LF · RF) and lets the model make the rest. Generate Take. 6-3. Live Path — steering The character walks while you drag a cone to steer it. Keys are written only when you Bake . ARDY must be connected. + adds a live take; set its Prompt · Rig · Seed · Enabled. Add Target makes the steering cone MF_Live_Target_1 and selects it. Start Live — drag or turn the cone. Esc or Stop Live ends it. Bake writes the keys, Discard throws them away, Reset All clears the ARDY rigs' keys, puts them back at rest (T-pose) and returns the timeline to its first frame — and puts every character they were retargeted onto back at rest too (6-6). Characters in the Share list (6-6) follow along during the run, posed rather than keyed; Bake fills them with keys. Option What it does Stop After Stops on its own after this many seconds ( 0 never) Face Target Direction Face where the cone's tip points Stream to Unreal / Stream Port Push the motion over TCP (default 9560): one JSON object a line (hello / frame / end), axis-angle per joint plus the root translation (metres, Y up). Unreal Live Link, Unity and others can drive a character from it Export Rig for Unreal (FBX) Saves the skeleton the stream lands on (cm, with a body). Import it in Unreal and drive it with a Live Link Pose node 6-4. Kimodo Kimodo runs its engine per take; a take takes tens of seconds to minutes and runs in the background . Pick With a Body / With Fingers and press + for a character. Fingers off: 30 joints; on: 77 joints with fingers. Body: ARDY's real skin on the 77, a simple proxy body over the joints on the 30. Each character has its own Enabled · Prompt · Seed (pick it in the list to edit). - takes it out of the list or deletes it (it asks); Add Selected adds a SOMA skeleton picked in the scene, including ones brought in from BVH or FBX. Set Duration · Denoising Steps (20 by default) · Prompt Strength · Constraint Strength · Reduce Foot Skating, then Generate Motion : every enabled character is generated in turn and keyed as it lands. While running the button reads Stop Waiting (the take in progress still finishes). Reset All clears every Kimodo character's keys, puts them back at rest (T-pose) and returns the timeline to its first frame. The characters the takes were retargeted onto (6-6) are reset with them. Export SOMA BVH / Reload Engine . 6-5. MotionBricks — walking Walks in a style with no prompt. Generate Motion only plans, and the plan plays right away from memory; Bake writes the keys. Control What it does + / - / Add Selected + asks for a SOMA Human or a Unitree G1 Robot ; - removes or deletes; Add Selected adds a picked skeleton. The person has the same Style, Go, Speed, Generate, Bake, Live and Retarget as the robot Take list (+ Take / - Take / Show Take) Every character has takes, each with its own style, direction or target, speed, seed and length. They run one after the other on one timeline (say frames 1-30, 31-90, 91-135); Generate Motion makes all the ticked ones, each starting where the one before ended, and Bake writes them into one animation. Show Take makes that stretch the playback range End on Pose Key (person) The take ends on the next pose key: move, turn and pose the character and key it on the frames it should arrive at (say 50 and 100); the take is made up to there, from the pose it starts on. Keys can be 19 to 59 frames apart at 30 fps. The keys stay, and Bake records the frames it made as generated Poses to Use (1-4) / Transition Early By (person) More than one pose gives the target a speed instead of a stop; Transition Early By lets the next take start on the way to the key, so the character flows through its poses Arrive in a Clip Pose (person) The take ends in a pose of a style's clip ( Clip , Clip Time ), placed at its Target or 2 m ahead; the model picks the length between Fewest and Most tokens With a Body Give new characters a simple body mesh Style Pick from the loaded styles Go In a Direction (keep walking) / To a Target (walk there and stop) Target / + An object's name or x z (scene units). + makes an arrow target — its +Z is the way the character faces on arrival Heading (deg) / Speed / Seed Direction in degrees / 0 uses the style's speed / where in the style the stride starts Duration / Reduce Foot Skating / Continue Length / foot planting / add to the previous plan Live Steer With : Ground Cursor (click the floor with Cursor Tool , or drag MF_MB_Cursor ) / Target Object (each to its own target). Move Characters Too : the Share list's characters follow. Lead : frames planned ahead. Esc stops it Cascadeur Link state, Connect/Disconnect , Refresh Bake / Discard Write the plan as keys / throw it away Reset All Stops a live run, drops any unbaked plan, then clears every MotionBricks character's keys and puts them back at rest along with the characters they were retargeted onto; the timeline returns to its first frame Styles The list is what the selected character can use ( Use Style , Refresh ). The person's 14 styles - idle, walk, slow walk, jog, run, injured, stealth, scared, zombie, happy, boxing, gun, and elbow and hand crawling - come with Install Engines ; Make Missing makes any that are missing (or that you deleted) with Kimodo in a few minutes; Save as Style adds your own from a baked or generated take (at least 60 frames). Install Engines also fetches the person's model (380 MB, NVIDIA's licence) and ONNX Runtime; it runs on the CPU, in a mayapy of its own Robot styles Style Name · Speed · Allowed Durations . Import FBX / BVH brings in a clip (its top node shows in Source , its joint naming in Rig Type ) and Convert to Style writes an .mbstyle (retargeted onto the MotionBricks skeleton; the engine's verdict on it is shown at once). Save as Style saves the selected character's animation (playback range) Reload Engine Load the engine again Maya has no BVH importer, so MotionForge reads BVH itself (rotation orders and frame rate included). 6-6. Retarget — onto your own character Source Rig — empty means the rig the newest take went onto; any MotionForge rig can be picked. A live take still waiting is baked first, and a rig with no keys sends the pose it is in. MMD models work both ways, with maya_mmd_tools installed. The MMD box at the top of this panel has Import MMD Model (PMX) and Import MMD Motion (VMD) ; an imported model appears in this list as MMD: <name> , and its keys are copied like any take. To put a take on an MMD model, set Rig Type to MMD model (Auto-Detect finds one too). Bones are read by their MMD names, so a model that calls its arm upperarm_L works as well as one that calls it left_arm . Torso and limbs are mapped; finger and twist bones are not yet. Select a joint of the receiving character - or its body mesh - and press Set Selected (or type a name). Referenced characters with a namespace ( Hero:Hips ) work as they are. A skeleton an importer left split under its body mesh (MetaHuman Builder's MMB_bodyShapeBof4|spine_04 ) is named by the mesh, and every joint under it is retargeted. When the character carries a second skeleton beside the body one (MetaHuman Builder's head rig, bone names and all), the body skeleton is the one driven and the copy follows it - live and baked - instead of the two being mapped onto one another. Rig Type — usually auto-detect. The two control rigs Maya animators work with are in the list: HumanIK Control Rig and mGear EPIC biped . The take is keyed onto their controls (the pelvis and legs onto the HumanIK effectors, whose channels are what that solver reads), and the character follows the controls. Method — MotionForge (joint by joint) / HumanIK (Maya) (both defined as HumanIK characters, driven by Maya's HumanIK, then baked). Retarget to Character . Option What it does Auto-Align Rest Pose Copes with limbs resting differently Auto Scale Motion Scales travel by the height ratio Match Floor Contact Keeps the feet on the floor every frame Legs on IK (checkbox in the Share With Characters box, below) Puts each foot where the source's is (from the character's own hip, scaled to its leg) and solves the knee as a two-joint IK — no foot sliding on a different build. It applies to Retarget to Character too Share With Characters — one take onto many characters + adds a row for the selected character. Each row: Source (empty = active rig) · Character · Rig Type · Enabled . With Fill Characters After Generating on, rows fill right after every Generate and Bake; Fill Characters does it now. During a live run (ARDY or MotionBricks) the characters follow as poses; a second skeleton on the same character (a MetaHuman head rig) follows with it. Reset All (in Live Path, Kimodo and MotionBricks) resets these characters along with its rigs: their keys are cut and their own rest pose comes back - Maya's bind pose , what Go to Bind Pose puts back, which on a MetaHuman Builder body is the whole pose it was skinned in (the root keeps -90) rather than every rotate channel at zero, which tipped the character over and dropped it through the floor. The rest is read off the skeleton, not off the pose the character is standing in: a live run sets a follower's bones without keying them, so a character it stopped on carries no animation at all, and taking that pose for its rest sent Reset All walking off to wherever the take had got to. A character whose skeleton carries no bind pose - one MotionForge built and never skinned - goes back to the pose it was found in, or, if it was already keyed before MotionForge saw it, to where its take begins. The rows and Target Rig are saved with the scene, so a character filled in an earlier session is put back too. SMPL-X body — when the Target Rig is an SMPL-X/SMPL-H skeleton, Export SMPL (.smpl) writes it (pick a Gender; Shape000… blend shapes are saved as the body shape). 6-7. Send to Cascadeur See chapter 7. 7. Cascadeur 7-1. Install (once) Install Cascadeur Plug-in in the window (or the menu) runs installer\integrations\cascadeur\install_mf_maya.bat . Allow Administrator when asked. It copies two Maya-only files ( mf_maya_link.py , mf_maya_apply.py ) into Cascadeur. They share neither file names nor ports with the Blender add-on's Cascadeur plug-in; both can be installed and running at once. Restart Cascadeur. In Cascadeur run Animation Scripts > MotionForge Maya Link (port 9574). What goes across is the selected skeleton — a MotionForge rig or your own character's joints. With nothing selected, the rig the newest take went onto. 7-2. Sending Control What it does Send Keyframes Only (keys onto the character Cascadeur already has) / Character and Bones (the character itself as FBX) With Mesh / With Animation Include the body / the animation (off sends the rest pose) Unify Skeleton When the skinned joints are split across hierarchies or driven by a control rig (constraints, IK, HumanIK), a one-tree copy of the skinned joints is built, the motion baked onto it, and that is sent. Your scene is untouched Fill Rig Mode (tick) Once the character has landed, fill Cascadeur's Quick Rigging Tool with this rig's joints Rig Type (Keyframes Only) The joint naming; the line below says "N bones matched" or why not Send Frame Range / Current Frame The playback range / this frame Status How many frames Cascadeur has received Fill Rig Mode (button) Fill Rig Mode now, for a character sent earlier Order matters : with no character in Cascadeur, send Character and Bones first, then keys, Live or Receive. The send keeps a copy of how the character landed on the rig, so restarting Cascadeur or Maya does not break reading back. 7-3. Live mirror Check the Link tests the link step by step and says where it stops (full report in the Script Editor). Mirror — Follow the Focus (the window you work in sends) / Maya to Cascadeur / Cascadeur to Maya . Bones — Mapped Bones / Whole Skeleton . Live: Mirror This Rig — press again or Esc to stop. Playing back keys every frame over there too. 7-4. Receiving (From Cascadeur) Control What it does Receive Animation Only (keys onto the selected skeleton) / Mesh + Animation (Cascadeur writes an FBX, Maya imports it as new objects) Whole Take Every frame Cascadeur holds; off reads the scene's playback range Timing Match Timing (back at the speed it left — undoes Cascadeur's frame-rate difference) / Fit Scene Range (stretch or squeeze to the range) / One For One (frame for frame) Receive from Cascadeur Read it 8. Good to know in Maya Situation What MotionForge does Scene unit is not cm (m, inch...) Works exactly: it computes in cm while it works and puts your unit back Undo Creating a rig, keying a take, Bake, Retarget and Receive are each one Ctrl+Z Scene frame rate An empty scene takes the take's rate (ARDY 20 · Kimodo/MotionBricks 30). A scene with other animation keeps its rate and the take is keyed at its true times Playback too fast "Play every frame" is switched to Real-time Generating again on the same rig The old take's keys are cleared first Turning past 180° The Euler filter runs automatically Saving and reopening / restarting Maya The rigs and every window setting and list come back ( motionforgeState node). Renamed joints are found again A rig parented under a moved group Motion lives in the rig's own space: move or turn the group and the take, waypoints and targets follow A skeleton from elsewhere (joints oriented any which way) Add Selected remembers each joint's rest orientation, so takes key onto it exactly A node already has a rig's name The rig gets non-clashing names Temp files Generation and send files older than 7 days are removed when the plug-in loads (Use Take works within that) 9. Reload — update without restarting Maya MotionForge > Reload MotionForge (shelf Reload ) New code goes live at once. A running Live, MotionBricks live run or Cascadeur mirror is stopped first, and ARDY disconnects. Rigs, takes, waypoints, pose keys, live takes, Kimodo/MotionBricks characters, the Share list and the settings stay. Reopen the window afterwards. 10. How it differs from Blender Nothing is left unported; every control in the window works. Some parts are done the Maya way: Blender Maya 3D cursor (Shift+right-click) MF_MB_Cursor locator + Cursor Tool (click the floor) Driving Rigify's leg IK (Legs on IK) A two-joint IK solved on the character's own legs; plus a HumanIK retarget method Merging Rigify's three skeletons (Unify Skeleton) A one-tree copy of the skinned joints with the control rig's motion baked Pose key IK bones Maya ikHandles with pole-vector locators Path curve (Bezier) NURBS curve BVH import (built into Blender) MotionForge's own BVH reader Rigify control rig mGear's EPIC biped (when mGear is installed) or the HumanIK Control Rig Engine install (manifests ship in the add-on) This repository ships no download manifests; point the Engine Folder at the one the Blender add-on installed 11. Troubleshooting Message / symptom Fix ARDY is not installed under the Engine Folder Set the folder with Set Engine Folder... and check Engine Status Create a rig first / "no rig" messages Make a rig with Create Rig (or the panel's + ) The take has N joints but the rig has M The rig was built for another model — press Create Rig again Live says engine off - press Connect ARDY first Press Connect ARDY first Cascadeur is not listening on ... Run MotionForge Maya Link in Cascadeur This Cascadeur's plugin has no ... (404) The Cascadeur-side files are older — run install_mf_maya.bat again and restart Cascadeur stale after connecting (different link version in Cascadeur) Run install_mf_maya.bat again and restart Cascadeur Generating takes long The window generates in the background; the first prompt is slow. Watch the status line and the Script Editor (the menu's one-click entries wait until done) The window is empty after Reload Reopen it with Open MotionForge Window 12. MMD characters, both ways - With maya_mmd_tools installed, the Retarget panel has an MMD box: Import MMD Model (PMX) and Import MMD Motion (VMD) . - An imported model is a source ( MMD: <name> in the list; its VMD keys are copied like any take) and a target (set Rig Type to MMD model ; Auto-Detect finds one too). Bones are read by their MMD names, so upperarm_L works as well as left_arm . - The legs are switched to FK for the bake, so the leg IK no longer holds them still: the knees stand as keyed from the first frame, the skin's D-bone legs follow, and the IK controllers ride along with the feet. Reset All switches the IK back on. The arm, elbow, hand and neck solvers are left alone.
docs.title: New

docs.text: Install Engines now updates too: a runtime file that differs from the published one is replaced, so a newer Kimodo, ARDY or MotionBricks runtime reaches an older install. A style you made or edited is never overwritten. The person's model and ONNX Runtime are shared with the Blender add-on's install, so one Engine Folder serves both. Installation now says exactly how to lay out the folder: rename the unzipped Maya_MotionForge-<version> folder to MotionForge , so MotionForge.mod sits directly inside the folder on MAYA_MODULE_PATH .
docs.title: Changed

docs.text: MMD target legs. The leg IK used to hold the legs still, bent the knees in the rest pose so the first frame was already folded, and left the skin's D-bone legs reading the idle solver - the body stood stiff while the FK bones moved. An MMD model registered as a group (what Set Selected makes) is recognised as an MMD model. Each take in the Live Path list has its own length.
docs.title: Fixed

docs.text: Item Details Maya Maya 2027 (Windows, 64-bit) Engines A MotionForge Engine Folder (ARDY · Kimodo · MotionBricks) — the same folder the Blender add-on uses works GPU ARDY is fast on a GPU (Vulkan); without one it runs on the CPU Cascadeur Optional. Only needed to send motion to Cascadeur or watch it live there
docs.title: 1. What you need

docs.text: The zip holds one folder, Maya_MotionForge-<version> . Unzip it, move that folder somewhere permanent and rename it MotionForge , e.g. C:\Users\<you>\Documents\maya\modules\MotionForge , so that MotionForge.mod sits directly inside it ( ...\MotionForge\MotionForge.mod , not one folder deeper). Keep MotionForge.mod at the root of that folder: it points at the scripts\ and plug-ins\ folders beside it, so copying the .mod on its own will not work. Any folder will do - if your Documents folder is redirected to OneDrive, use the path Explorer shows you. Then put that folder on MAYA_MODULE_PATH , one of two ways: Environment variable : Windows > System Properties > Environment Variables > New user variable MAYA_MODULE_PATH = C:\Users\<you>\Documents\maya\modules\MotionForge . If it already exists, append ;C:\Users\<you>\Documents\maya\modules\MotionForge . Maya.env : add the same line to the Maya.env file of your Maya version (e.g. C:\Users\<you>\Documents\maya\2027\Maya.env ): MAYA_MODULE_PATH = C:\Users\<you>\Documents\maya\modules\MotionForge Restart Maya.
docs.title: 2-1. Register the module (once)

docs.text: In Windows > Settings/Preferences > Plug-in Manager , tick Loaded for MotionForge . Tick Auto load too if you want it every session. A MotionForge menu appears in the menu bar.
docs.title: 2-2. Load the plug-in

docs.text: Run once in the Script Editor's Python tab: exec ( open ( r "C:\Users\<you>\Documents\maya\modules\MotionForge\scripts\motionforge_shelf.py" ) . read ()) This creates the MotionForge shelf: Load · Window · Connect · Rig · Generate · Kimodo · MB · Retarget · Reload . Running it again does not duplicate the shelf.
docs.title: 2-3. Shelf (optional)

docs.text: Choose the Engine Folder with MotionForge > Set Engine Folder... . Inside it: <Engine Folder>\ ├── ardy\ ARDY (bin\ardy-server.exe, models\*.gguf, assets\cskel27\) ├── kimodo\ Kimodo (generator + text encoder) └── motionbricks\ MotionBricks (DLL + styles) └── soma\ the person: ONNX model, ONNX Runtime, 14 styles MotionForge > Engine Status prints ready (or what is missing) for each engine in the Script Editor. Updating. Install Engines also updates: a runtime file that differs from the published one is replaced, so a newer Kimodo, ARDY or MotionBricks runtime reaches an older install, and the person's styles are fetched with it. Check for Updates (in the window, or MotionForge > Check for Engine Updates ) says what is newer without downloading it, and turns the button into Update Engines when there is something. A style you made or edited is never overwritten. The person's model and ONNX Runtime are shared with the Blender add-on's install, so one Engine Folder serves both.
docs.title: 3. First-time setup — the Engine Folder

docs.text: Where What it does MotionForge menu Open the window, connect/disconnect ARDY, create a rig, one-click generation (ARDY · Kimodo · MotionBricks), retarget, Engine Folder, Engine Status, Install Engines, Install Cascadeur Plug-in, Reload, About Shelf The same one-click entries MotionForge window The full tool. Open MotionForge Window (shelf Window ) docks it on the right; it can be floated or tabbed The window carries Blender's seven panels in the same order, with the same names , and every control works. MotionForge — engines, connection, rigs, HumanIK Text to Motion — takes from text Live Path — steering in real time Kimodo — the Kimodo engine (several characters) MotionBricks — the walking engine (several characters, live, styles) Retarget — onto your own character Send to Cascadeur — to Cascadeur and back Every setting and list in the window (takes, waypoints, pose keys, live takes, Kimodo and MotionBricks characters, the Share list) is saved with the scene and comes back when it is reopened. The line at the top shows what the last button did, or why it failed.
docs.title: 4. Where things are

docs.text: MotionForge > Connect ARDY — loads the model (seconds). MotionForge > Create Rig — a 27-joint rig with its body mesh. MotionForge > Generate Motion... — type a person walks forward . The take is keyed and the scene is set to the engine's rate (ARDY: 20 fps) with real-time playback. Play it. The first generation can take a while while the text encoder warms up (about 100 s on this PC); later ones are quick. The window's Generate buttons run in the background , so Maya stays usable; the status line shows progress.
docs.title: 5. Your first animation (5 minutes)

docs.text: Control What it does Engines box Each engine's state ( ready or what is missing) and the Engine Folder Set Engine Folder Choose the Engine Folder Install Engines Download the engines (in the background with progress; press again to stop). If this repository carries no engine download manifests it says so — point the Engine Folder at the one the Blender add-on installed Install Cascadeur Plug-in Runs install_mf_maya.bat (asks for Administrator) Connect ARDY / Disconnect Start and stop the ARDY engine (connecting runs in the background). Disconnecting frees GPU memory Skip Text Encoder Connect without the text encoder (no prompts, faster) Ping Whether ARDY answers, and how fast Create Rig / Create Skin A joint rig of the engine's skeleton, with its body mesh HumanIK Character When on, every new rig (ARDY · Kimodo · MotionBricks) is defined as a HumanIK character Generated Rigs / Use Rig The rigs made so far; the picked one becomes the generation target Define as HumanIK Define the selected rig — or your character's joints — as a HumanIK character. A character's joints are read with Retarget's Rig Type Control Rig Build the HumanIK Control Rig (FK/IK controls)
docs.title: 6-1. MotionForge — engines, connection, rigs

docs.text: With mGear (open source, MIT) installed in Maya, a MotionForge character can wear mGear's EPIC biped control rig . Generated takes are keyed onto the mGear controls (FK and IK both), and the character follows the controls, so generated motion is polished like any keyframed animation. Without mGear these buttons are greyed out with the reason shown. Button What it does Build mGear Rig Fits mGear's guide onto the selected character (any joint of it) and builds the rig. A take already on it is baked onto the controls and connected. A 77-joint character gets finger controls too Bake Take to mGear Bakes a new take onto the controls (arms and legs in FK and IK both — switch with arm_blend / leg_blend ) Connect / Disconnect The controls drive the character / the character plays its own keys again Remove Deletes the mGear rig and guide; the character keeps its keys mGear builds one biped per scene. Remove it before rigging another character. With knees and elbows bending as hinges, FK and IK both match the original motion within 0.5 cm. IK poles are placed in the plane the limb actually bends in, frame by frame.
docs.title: mGear (when installed)

docs.text: A take is one generation: its own prompt, length, seed, target rig and path curve. With no takes the panel shows a "Start here" line. Control What it does + / - Add or remove a take. A new take copies the previous one's prompt and length Use Take Put a generated take back on its rig Prompt / Preset What happens. Preset offers example sentences Source Rig The rig this take goes onto; (active source) is the active rig Duration / Seed Length in seconds / -1 differs every time, a number repeats a result Include in Generate All Off leaves the take out of Generate All Continue from the take above Starts where the take above ended Create Curve / Disconnect Curve A path (NURBS curve) for this take alone, or disconnect it. A take with a curve walks the curve instead of the waypoints (facing along it with Face Waypoint Direction) Reduce Foot Skating Foot-skate fix (when off, a warning says waypoints and pose keys will only be approximate) Denoising Steps / Prompt Strength / Constraint Strength Quality and how hard prompt and constraints are followed Generate Take / Generate All (n) The selected take / every enabled take. While generating, Generate All becomes Stop Stream to Unreal / Stream Port Send the finished takes out live (see 6-3) Waypoints — "pass through here on this frame" Turn on Follow Waypoints . Put the time slider on a frame and press + : an MF_Waypoint_01 locator appears (at the selected object or the origin, facing the way the rig faces). Pick one in the list to change its Frame / Enabled . Face Waypoint Direction makes the character face the locator's +Z. Waypoints are read relative to the rig : put the rig in a group and move or turn the group, and it still walks to where they were placed. Pose keys — "hold this pose on this frame" Turn on Use Pose Keys . On the frame you want, press + : a copy of the rig, MF_Pose_001 , appears. Pose Key (shown as Pose once a key is picked) jumps to the key's frame and selects its rig. IK On gives the arms and legs Maya ikHandles (rotate-plane, with pole vectors) to pose by the hands and feet; IK Off keeps the pose in the joints and removes the handles. Pin : Whole Body holds every joint; Parts holds only the hands and feet ticked (LH · RH · LF · RF) and lets the model make the rest. Generate Take.
docs.title: 6-2. Text to Motion — takes

docs.text: The character walks while you drag a cone to steer it. Keys are written only when you Bake . ARDY must be connected. + adds a live take; set its Prompt · Rig · Seed · Enabled. Add Target makes the steering cone MF_Live_Target_1 and selects it. Start Live — drag or turn the cone. Esc or Stop Live ends it. Bake writes the keys, Discard throws them away, Reset All clears the ARDY rigs' keys, puts them back at rest (T-pose) and returns the timeline to its first frame — and puts every character they were retargeted onto back at rest too (6-6). Characters in the Share list (6-6) follow along during the run, posed rather than keyed; Bake fills them with keys. Option What it does Stop After Stops on its own after this many seconds ( 0 never) Face Target Direction Face where the cone's tip points Stream to Unreal / Stream Port Push the motion over TCP (default 9560): one JSON object a line (hello / frame / end), axis-angle per joint plus the root translation (metres, Y up). Unreal Live Link, Unity and others can drive a character from it Export Rig for Unreal (FBX) Saves the skeleton the stream lands on (cm, with a body). Import it in Unreal and drive it with a Live Link Pose node
docs.title: 6-3. Live Path — steering

docs.text: Kimodo runs its engine per take; a take takes tens of seconds to minutes and runs in the background . Pick With a Body / With Fingers and press + for a character. Fingers off: 30 joints; on: 77 joints with fingers. Body: ARDY's real skin on the 77, a simple proxy body over the joints on the 30. Each character has its own Enabled · Prompt · Seed (pick it in the list to edit). - takes it out of the list or deletes it (it asks); Add Selected adds a SOMA skeleton picked in the scene, including ones brought in from BVH or FBX. Set Duration · Denoising Steps (20 by default) · Prompt Strength · Constraint Strength · Reduce Foot Skating, then Generate Motion : every enabled character is generated in turn and keyed as it lands. While running the button reads Stop Waiting (the take in progress still finishes). Reset All clears every Kimodo character's keys, puts them back at rest (T-pose) and returns the timeline to its first frame. The characters the takes were retargeted onto (6-6) are reset with them. Export SOMA BVH / Reload Engine .
docs.title: 6-4. Kimodo

docs.text: Walks in a style with no prompt. Generate Motion only plans, and the plan plays right away from memory; Bake writes the keys. Control What it does + / - / Add Selected + asks for a SOMA Human or a Unitree G1 Robot ; - removes or deletes; Add Selected adds a picked skeleton. The person has the same Style, Go, Speed, Generate, Bake, Live and Retarget as the robot Take list (+ Take / - Take / Show Take) Every character has takes, each with its own style, direction or target, speed, seed and length. They run one after the other on one timeline (say frames 1-30, 31-90, 91-135); Generate Motion makes all the ticked ones, each starting where the one before ended, and Bake writes them into one animation. Show Take makes that stretch the playback range End on Pose Key (person) The take ends on the next pose key: move, turn and pose the character and key it on the frames it should arrive at (say 50 and 100); the take is made up to there, from the pose it starts on. Keys can be 19 to 59 frames apart at 30 fps. The keys stay, and Bake records the frames it made as generated Poses to Use (1-4) / Transition Early By (person) More than one pose gives the target a speed instead of a stop; Transition Early By lets the next take start on the way to the key, so the character flows through its poses Arrive in a Clip Pose (person) The take ends in a pose of a style's clip ( Clip , Clip Time ), placed at its Target or 2 m ahead; the model picks the length between Fewest and Most tokens With a Body Give new characters a simple body mesh Style Pick from the loaded styles Go In a Direction (keep walking) / To a Target (walk there and stop) Target / + An object's name or x z (scene units). + makes an arrow target — its +Z is the way the character faces on arrival Heading (deg) / Speed / Seed Direction in degrees / 0 uses the style's speed / where in the style the stride starts Duration / Reduce Foot Skating / Continue Length / foot planting / add to the previous plan Live Steer With : Ground Cursor (click the floor with Cursor Tool , or drag MF_MB_Cursor ) / Target Object (each to its own target). Move Characters Too : the Share list's characters follow. Lead : frames planned ahead. Esc stops it Cascadeur Link state, Connect/Disconnect , Refresh Bake / Discard Write the plan as keys / throw it away Reset All Stops a live run, drops any unbaked plan, then clears every MotionBricks character's keys and puts them back at rest along with the characters they were retargeted onto; the timeline returns to its first frame Styles The list is what the selected character can use ( Use Style , Refresh ). The person's 14 styles - idle, walk, slow walk, jog, run, injured, stealth, scared, zombie, happy, boxing, gun, and elbow and hand crawling - come with Install Engines ; Make Missing makes any that are missing (or that you deleted) with Kimodo in a few minutes; Save as Style adds your own from a baked or generated take (at least 60 frames). Install Engines also fetches the person's model (380 MB, NVIDIA's licence) and ONNX Runtime; it runs on the CPU, in a mayapy of its own Robot styles Style Name · Speed · Allowed Durations . Import FBX / BVH brings in a clip (its top node shows in Source , its joint naming in Rig Type ) and Convert to Style writes an .mbstyle (retargeted onto the MotionBricks skeleton; the engine's verdict on it is shown at once). Save as Style saves the selected character's animation (playback range) Reload Engine Load the engine again Maya has no BVH importer, so MotionForge reads BVH itself (rotation orders and frame rate included).
docs.title: 6-5. MotionBricks — walking

docs.text: Source Rig — empty means the rig the newest take went onto; any MotionForge rig can be picked. A live take still waiting is baked first, and a rig with no keys sends the pose it is in. MMD models work both ways, with maya_mmd_tools installed. The MMD box at the top of this panel has Import MMD Model (PMX) and Import MMD Motion (VMD) ; an imported model appears in this list as MMD: <name> , and its keys are copied like any take. To put a take on an MMD model, set Rig Type to MMD model (Auto-Detect finds one too). Bones are read by their MMD names, so a model that calls its arm upperarm_L works as well as one that calls it left_arm . Torso and limbs are mapped; finger and twist bones are not yet. Select a joint of the receiving character - or its body mesh - and press Set Selected (or type a name). Referenced characters with a namespace ( Hero:Hips ) work as they are. A skeleton an importer left split under its body mesh (MetaHuman Builder's MMB_bodyShapeBof4|spine_04 ) is named by the mesh, and every joint under it is retargeted. When the character carries a second skeleton beside the body one (MetaHuman Builder's head rig, bone names and all), the body skeleton is the one driven and the copy follows it - live and baked - instead of the two being mapped onto one another. Rig Type — usually auto-detect. The two control rigs Maya animators work with are in the list: HumanIK Control Rig and mGear EPIC biped . The take is keyed onto their controls (the pelvis and legs onto the HumanIK effectors, whose channels are what that solver reads), and the character follows the controls. Method — MotionForge (joint by joint) / HumanIK (Maya) (both defined as HumanIK characters, driven by Maya's HumanIK, then baked). Retarget to Character . Option What it does Auto-Align Rest Pose Copes with limbs resting differently Auto Scale Motion Scales travel by the height ratio Match Floor Contact Keeps the feet on the floor every frame Legs on IK (checkbox in the Share With Characters box, below) Puts each foot where the source's is (from the character's own hip, scaled to its leg) and solves the knee as a two-joint IK — no foot sliding on a different build. It applies to Retarget to Character too Share With Characters — one take onto many characters + adds a row for the selected character. Each row: Source (empty = active rig) · Character · Rig Type · Enabled . With Fill Characters After Generating on, rows fill right after every Generate and Bake; Fill Characters does it now. During a live run (ARDY or MotionBricks) the characters follow as poses; a second skeleton on the same character (a MetaHuman head rig) follows with it. Reset All (in Live Path, Kimodo and MotionBricks) resets these characters along with its rigs: their keys are cut and their own rest pose comes back - Maya's bind pose , what Go to Bind Pose puts back, which on a MetaHuman Builder body is the whole pose it was skinned in (the root keeps -90) rather than every rotate channel at zero, which tipped the character over and dropped it through the floor. The rest is read off the skeleton, not off the pose the character is standing in: a live run sets a follower's bones without keying them, so a character it stopped on carries no animation at all, and taking that pose for its rest sent Reset All walking off to wherever the take had got to. A character whose skeleton carries no bind pose - one MotionForge built and never skinned - goes back to the pose it was found in, or, if it was already keyed before MotionForge saw it, to where its take begins. The rows and Target Rig are saved with the scene, so a character filled in an earlier session is put back too. SMPL-X body — when the Target Rig is an SMPL-X/SMPL-H skeleton, Export SMPL (.smpl) writes it (pick a Gender; Shape000… blend shapes are saved as the body shape).

docs.title: 6-7. Send to Cascadeur

docs.text: Install Cascadeur Plug-in in the window (or the menu) runs installer\integrations\cascadeur\install_mf_maya.bat . Allow Administrator when asked. It copies two Maya-only files ( mf_maya_link.py , mf_maya_apply.py ) into Cascadeur. They share neither file names nor ports with the Blender add-on's Cascadeur plug-in; both can be installed and running at once. Restart Cascadeur. In Cascadeur run Animation Scripts > MotionForge Maya Link (port 9574). What goes across is the selected skeleton — a MotionForge rig or your own character's joints. With nothing selected, the rig the newest take went onto.
docs.title: 7-1. Install (once)

docs.text: Control What it does Send Keyframes Only (keys onto the character Cascadeur already has) / Character and Bones (the character itself as FBX) With Mesh / With Animation Include the body / the animation (off sends the rest pose) Unify Skeleton When the skinned joints are split across hierarchies or driven by a control rig (constraints, IK, HumanIK), a one-tree copy of the skinned joints is built, the motion baked onto it, and that is sent. Your scene is untouched Fill Rig Mode (tick) Once the character has landed, fill Cascadeur's Quick Rigging Tool with this rig's joints Rig Type (Keyframes Only) The joint naming; the line below says "N bones matched" or why not Send Frame Range / Current Frame The playback range / this frame Status How many frames Cascadeur has received Fill Rig Mode (button) Fill Rig Mode now, for a character sent earlier Order matters : with no character in Cascadeur, send Character and Bones first, then keys, Live or Receive. The send keeps a copy of how the character landed on the rig, so restarting Cascadeur or Maya does not break reading back.
docs.title: 7-2. Sending

docs.text: Check the Link tests the link step by step and says where it stops (full report in the Script Editor). Mirror — Follow the Focus (the window you work in sends) / Maya to Cascadeur / Cascadeur to Maya . Bones — Mapped Bones / Whole Skeleton . Live: Mirror This Rig — press again or Esc to stop. Playing back keys every frame over there too.
docs.title: 7-3. Live mirror

docs.text: Control What it does Receive Animation Only (keys onto the selected skeleton) / Mesh + Animation (Cascadeur writes an FBX, Maya imports it as new objects) Whole Take Every frame Cascadeur holds; off reads the scene's playback range Timing Match Timing (back at the speed it left — undoes Cascadeur's frame-rate difference) / Fit Scene Range (stretch or squeeze to the range) / One For One (frame for frame) Receive from Cascadeur Read it
docs.title: 7-4. Receiving (From Cascadeur)

docs.text: Situation What MotionForge does Scene unit is not cm (m, inch...) Works exactly: it computes in cm while it works and puts your unit back Undo Creating a rig, keying a take, Bake, Retarget and Receive are each one Ctrl+Z Scene frame rate An empty scene takes the take's rate (ARDY 20 · Kimodo/MotionBricks 30). A scene with other animation keeps its rate and the take is keyed at its true times Playback too fast "Play every frame" is switched to Real-time Generating again on the same rig The old take's keys are cleared first Turning past 180° The Euler filter runs automatically Saving and reopening / restarting Maya The rigs and every window setting and list come back ( motionforgeState node). Renamed joints are found again A rig parented under a moved group Motion lives in the rig's own space: move or turn the group and the take, waypoints and targets follow A skeleton from elsewhere (joints oriented any which way) Add Selected remembers each joint's rest orientation, so takes key onto it exactly A node already has a rig's name The rig gets non-clashing names Temp files Generation and send files older than 7 days are removed when the plug-in loads (Use Take works within that)
docs.title: 8. Good to know in Maya

docs.text: MotionForge > Reload MotionForge (shelf Reload ) New code goes live at once. A running Live, MotionBricks live run or Cascadeur mirror is stopped first, and ARDY disconnects. Rigs, takes, waypoints, pose keys, live takes, Kimodo/MotionBricks characters, the Share list and the settings stay. Reopen the window afterwards.
docs.title: 9. Reload — update without restarting Maya

docs.text: Nothing is left unported; every control in the window works. Some parts are done the Maya way: Blender Maya 3D cursor (Shift+right-click) MF_MB_Cursor locator + Cursor Tool (click the floor) Driving Rigify's leg IK (Legs on IK) A two-joint IK solved on the character's own legs; plus a HumanIK retarget method Merging Rigify's three skeletons (Unify Skeleton) A one-tree copy of the skinned joints with the control rig's motion baked Pose key IK bones Maya ikHandles with pole-vector locators Path curve (Bezier) NURBS curve BVH import (built into Blender) MotionForge's own BVH reader Rigify control rig mGear's EPIC biped (when mGear is installed) or the HumanIK Control Rig Engine install (manifests ship in the add-on) This repository ships no download manifests; point the Engine Folder at the one the Blender add-on installed

docs.text: MotionForge for Maya — 사용 가이드 텍스트 한 줄로 캐릭터 모션을 만들고, 내 캐릭터에 옮기고, Cascadeur로 보내는 Maya 플러그인입니다. Blender 애드온 MotionForge v0.5.0을 Maya 2027로 이식했습니다. 모든 엔진은 내 컴퓨터에서 돌아가며 인터넷으로 아무것도 보내지 않습니다. English: index.md 0.2.0 새 기능 0.1.0에서 올라오는 경우: 0.2.0을 설치한 뒤 MotionForge 창에서 Install Engines 를 한 번 눌러 주세요. 엔진 폴더의 MotionBricks 런타임을 새 것으로 바꾸고, 사람(SOMA Human)이 쓰는 모델과 스타일도 받습니다. 옆의 Check for Updates 는 내려받지 않고 무엇이 새로운지 알려 줍니다. 새로 추가 MotionBricks에 사람이 들어옴 - MotionBricks 패널의 + 를 누르면 SOMA Human 과 Unitree G1 Robot 중에서 고릅니다. 사람도 로봇과 같은 Style, Go, Speed, Generate Motion , Bake , Live , Retarget을 씁니다. - 사람의 스타일 14개(idle, walk, slow walk, jog, run, injured, stealth, scared, zombie, happy, boxing, gun, 팔꿈치·손 기기)는 Install Engines 가 함께 설치합니다. 빠진 것이 있으면 Styles 상자의 Make Missing 이 Kimodo로 만들고, Save as Style 은 구운(Bake) 또는 생성한 테이크를 내 스타일로 저장합니다. - Install Engines 가 사람용 모델(380 MB)을 NVIDIA 라이선스와 함께 받습니다. 별도의 mayapy에서 CPU로 돌기 때문에 GPU가 필요 없습니다. 사람과 로봇 모두 테이크 - 캐릭터마다 테이크 목록( + Take / - Take / Show Take )이 있습니다. 테이크는 자기 스타일, 방향 또는 타겟, 속도, 시드, 길이를 갖고 씬과 함께 저장됩니다. - 테이크는 하나의 타임라인에 차례로 이어지고(예: 1-30, 31-90, 91-135프레임), Generate Motion 은 체크된 테이크를 앞 테이크가 끝난 자리에서 이어서 만듭니다. Bake 는 하나의 애니메이션으로 기록합니다. 포즈 투 포즈 - 사람의 테이크에서 End on Pose Key 를 켭니다. 캐릭터를 옮기고 돌리고 포즈를 잡아 도착할 프레임(예: 50, 100)에 키를 넣으면, 각 테이크는 자기 키까지 시작한 포즈에서 만들어집니다. 키 간격은 30fps 기준 19~59프레임입니다. - Poses to Use (1~4)와 Transition Early By 로 멈추지 않고 여러 포즈를 지나며 움직입니다. Arrive in a Clip Pose 는 스타일 클립의 한 포즈에서 끝나는 테이크를 만듭니다. MMD 캐릭터 양방향 - maya_mmd_tools 를 설치하면 Retarget 패널에 MMD 상자가 생깁니다: Import MMD Model (PMX) , Import MMD Motion (VMD) . - 불러온 모델은 소스 (목록에 MMD: <이름> , VMD 키를 다른 테이크처럼 옮김)로도, 타겟 ( Rig Type 을 MMD model 로, Auto-Detect로도 찾음)으로도 쓸 수 있습니다. 본은 MMD 이름으로 읽어서 upperarm_L 이든 left_arm 이든 똑같이 동작합니다. - 굽기 동안 다리를 FK로 바꿔서 다리 IK가 다리를 붙잡지 않습니다. 첫 프레임부터 무릎이 키대로 서 있고, 스킨이 묶인 D본 다리가 함께 움직이며, IK 컨트롤러도 발을 따라갑니다. Reset All 은 IK를 다시 켭니다. 팔·팔꿈치·손·목 솔버는 건드리지 않습니다. 바뀐 점 Install Engines 가 업데이트도 합니다. 공개된 런타임과 다른 파일은 교체되어, 예전 설치에도 새 Kimodo·ARDY·MotionBricks 런타임이 반영됩니다. 직접 만들거나 고친 스타일은 덮어쓰지 않습니다. 사람 모델과 ONNX Runtime은 Blender 애드온 설치와 공유되므로 엔진 폴더 하나로 둘 다 씁니다. 설치 안내에 폴더 구성을 정확히 적었습니다: 압축을 푼 Maya_MotionForge-<버전> 폴더 이름을 MotionForge 로 바꿔서, MAYA_MODULE_PATH 에 넣은 폴더 바로 안에 MotionForge.mod 가 있게 합니다. 고친 점 MMD 타겟의 다리. 다리 IK가 다리를 붙잡고, 기본 자세에서도 무릎을 굽혀 첫 프레임부터 접혀 있었으며, 스킨이 묶인 D본 다리가 멈춘 솔버를 읽어 FK가 움직여도 몸이 뻣뻣했습니다. 그룹으로 등록한 MMD 모델(Set Selected가 만드는 것)을 MMD 모델로 인식합니다. Live Path 목록의 테이크마다 길이가 따로 있습니다. 1. 준비물 항목 내용 Maya Maya 2027 (Windows 64비트) 엔진 MotionForge 엔진 폴더 (ARDY · Kimodo · MotionBricks) — Blender 애드온과 같은 폴더를 함께 써도 됩니다 GPU ARDY는 GPU(Vulkan)를 쓰면 빠릅니다. 없으면 CPU로 동작합니다 Cascadeur 선택 사항. Cascadeur로 보내거나 실시간으로 볼 때만 필요합니다 2. 설치 2-1. 모듈 등록 (한 번만) zip 안에는 Maya_MotionForge-<버전> 폴더 하나가 들어 있습니다. 압축을 풀고 그 폴더를 항상 쓸 위치로 옮긴 뒤 이름을 MotionForge 로 바꿉니다 (예: C:\Users\<사용자>\Documents\maya\modules\MotionForge ). MotionForge.mod 가 그 폴더 바로 안에 있어야 합니다 ( ...\MotionForge\MotionForge.mod — 한 단계 더 안쪽이면 안 됩니다). MotionForge.mod 는 그 폴더의 맨 위에 그대로 두세요 — 바로 옆의 scripts\ , plug-ins\ 폴더를 가리키고 있어서 .mod 파일만 복사하면 동작하지 않습니다. 폴더 위치는 아무 데나 좋습니다 — 문서 폴더가 OneDrive로 리디렉션되어 있다면 탐색기에 보이는 실제 경로를 쓰세요. 그다음 그 폴더를 MAYA_MODULE_PATH 에 넣습니다. 방법은 둘 중 하나입니다. 환경 변수 : Windows > 시스템 속성 > 환경 변수 > 사용자 변수 새로 만들기 — MAYA_MODULE_PATH = C:\Users\<사용자>\Documents\maya\modules\MotionForge . 이미 있으면 뒤에 ;C:\Users\<사용자>\Documents\maya\modules\MotionForge 를 이어 붙입니다. Maya.env : 해당 버전의 Maya.env 파일(예: C:\Users\<사용자>\Documents\maya\2027\Maya.env )에 같은 줄을 추가합니다. MAYA_MODULE_PATH = C:\Users\<사용자>\Documents\maya\modules\MotionForge Maya를 다시 시작하세요. 2-2. 플러그인 켜기 Windows > Settings/Preferences > Plug-in Manager 에서 MotionForge 의 Loaded 를 켭니다. 매번 켜지게 하려면 Auto load 도 켜세요. 메뉴 바에 MotionForge 메뉴가 생기면 성공입니다. 2-3. 셸프 (선택) Script Editor의 Python 탭에서 한 번 실행합니다. exec ( open ( r "C:\Users\<사용자>\Documents\maya\modules\MotionForge\scripts\motionforge_shelf.py" ) . read ()) MotionForge 셸프가 생깁니다: Load · Window · Connect · Rig · Generate · Kimodo · MB · Retarget · Reload . 여러 번 실행해도 셸프가 중복되지 않습니다. 3. 처음 설정 — 엔진 폴더 MotionForge > Set Engine Folder... 에서 엔진 폴더를 고릅니다. 폴더 안은 이렇게 생겼습니다. <엔진 폴더>\ ├── ardy\ ARDY (bin\ardy-server.exe, models\*.gguf, assets\cskel27\) ├── kimodo\ Kimodo (생성기 + 텍스트 인코더) └── motionbricks\ MotionBricks (DLL + 스타일) └── soma\ 사람: ONNX 모델, ONNX Runtime, 스타일 14개 MotionForge > Engine Status 를 누르면 Script Editor에 엔진마다 ready 또는 빠진 것이 출력됩니다. 업데이트. Install Engines 는 업데이트도 합니다. 공개된 런타임과 다른 파일은 교체되어, 예전 설치에도 새 Kimodo·ARDY·MotionBricks 런타임이 반영되고 사람 스타일도 함께 받습니다. Check for Updates (창, 또는 MotionForge > Check for Engine Updates )는 내려받지 않고 무엇이 새로운지 알려 주며, 새 것이 있으면 버튼이 Update Engines 로 바뀝니다. 직접 만들거나 고친 스타일은 덮어쓰지 않습니다. 사람 모델과 ONNX Runtime은 Blender 애드온 설치와 공유되므로 엔진 폴더 하나로 둘 다 씁니다. 4. 화면 구성 위치 하는 일 MotionForge 메뉴 창 열기, ARDY 연결·끊기, 리그 만들기, 원클릭 생성(ARDY · Kimodo · MotionBricks), 리타겟, 엔진 폴더, Engine Status , 엔진 설치, Cascadeur 플러그인 설치, Reload, About 셸프 메뉴와 같은 원클릭 기능 MotionForge 창 전체 기능. Open MotionForge Window (셸프 Window )로 열면 오른쪽에 도킹됩니다. 떼어내기·탭 합치기 가능 창에는 Blender와 같은 순서, 같은 이름 으로 7개 패널이 있고, 모든 버튼이 동작합니다. MotionForge — 엔진, 연결, 리그, HumanIK Text to Motion — 텍스트로 테이크 만들기 Live Path — 실시간 조종 Kimodo — Kimodo 엔진 (여러 캐릭터) MotionBricks — 걷기 엔진 (여러 캐릭터, 라이브, 스타일) Retarget — 내 캐릭터에 옮기기 Send to Cascadeur — Cascadeur로 보내고 받아오기 창의 모든 설정과 목록(테이크, 웨이포인트, 포즈키, 라이브 테이크, Kimodo·MotionBricks 캐릭터, Share 목록)은 씬과 함께 저장 됩니다. 씬을 다시 열면 그대로 돌아옵니다. 맨 위의 한 줄에 방금 누른 버튼의 결과나 오류가 표시됩니다. 5. 첫 번째 애니메이션 (5분) MotionForge > Connect ARDY — 모델을 불러옵니다 (수 초). MotionForge > Create Rig — 27관절 리그와 몸 메쉬가 생깁니다. MotionForge > Generate Motion... — 프롬프트에 a person walks forward 를 입력합니다. 키프레임이 들어가고, 씬이 엔진 속도(ARDY는 20fps)와 실시간 재생으로 맞춰집니다. 재생해 보세요. 첫 생성은 텍스트 인코더를 준비하느라 오래 걸릴 수 있습니다 (이 PC 기준 약 100초). 두 번째부터는 빠릅니다. 창의 Generate 버튼은 백그라운드 로 생성하므로 그동안에도 Maya를 계속 쓸 수 있습니다. 진행 상황은 상태 줄에 나옵니다. 6. 패널별 사용법 6-1. MotionForge — 엔진, 연결, 리그 컨트롤 설명 Engines 상자 세 엔진의 상태( ready 또는 빠진 것)와 엔진 폴더 Set Engine Folder 엔진 폴더 지정 Install Engines 엔진 다운로드(백그라운드, 진행률 표시, 다시 누르면 중지). 엔진 다운로드 목록 파일이 이 저장소에 없으면 그렇다고 알려 줍니다 — 그 경우 Blender 애드온으로 설치한 엔진 폴더를 그대로 지정하면 됩니다 Install Cascadeur Plug-in install_mf_maya.bat 실행 (관리자 권한 요청) Connect ARDY / Disconnect ARDY 엔진을 켜고 끕니다 (연결도 백그라운드). 끄면 GPU 메모리가 비워집니다 Skip Text Encoder 텍스트 인코더 없이 연결합니다 (프롬프트 생성은 안 됨, 빠름) Ping ARDY 엔진이 응답하는지와 응답 시간 Create Rig / Create Skin 엔진 골격으로 조인트 리그를 만들고, 몸 메쉬를 붙입니다 HumanIK Character 켜 두면 새로 만드는 모든 리그(ARDY · Kimodo · MotionBricks)를 HumanIK 캐릭터로 정의 합니다 Generated Rigs / Use Rig 만든 리그 목록. 고른 리그를 생성 대상으로 씁니다 Define as HumanIK 선택한 리그(또는 내 캐릭터의 조인트)를 HumanIK 캐릭터로 정의합니다. 내 캐릭터는 Retarget의 Rig Type으로 뼈 이름을 해석합니다 Control Rig HumanIK Control Rig(FK/IK 컨트롤)를 만듭니다 mGear (설치되어 있으면) mGear (오픈소스, MIT)를 마야에 설치해 두면 MotionForge 캐릭터에 mGear EPIC 바이패드 컨트롤 리그 를 씌울 수 있습니다. AI가 만든 테이크가 mGear 컨트롤(FK·IK 모두)에 키로 들어가고, 캐릭터는 그 컨트롤을 따라 움직입니다. 생성된 모션을 일반 키프레임 작업처럼 다듬을 수 있습니다. mGear가 없으면 이 버튼들은 비활성화되고 이유가 표시됩니다. 버튼 설명 Build mGear Rig 선택한 캐릭터(조인트 아무거나)에 mGear 가이드를 맞추고 리그를 빌드합니다. 테이크가 있으면 바로 컨트롤에 베이크하고 연결합니다. 77관절이면 손가락 컨트롤까지 만듭니다 Bake Take to mGear 새로 만든 테이크를 컨트롤에 다시 베이크합니다 (팔다리는 FK와 IK 모두 — arm_blend / leg_blend 로 바로 전환 가능) Connect / Disconnect 컨트롤이 캐릭터를 움직이게 / 캐릭터가 자기 키로 다시 재생하게 Remove mGear 리그와 가이드를 지웁니다. 캐릭터의 키는 남습니다 mGear는 한 씬에 바이패드 하나만 빌드합니다. 다른 캐릭터에 쓰려면 먼저 Remove 하세요. 무릎·팔꿈치처럼 경첩으로 굽는 관절은 FK와 IK 모두 원래 동작과 0.5cm 이내로 맞습니다. IK 다리·팔의 폴 벡터는 매 프레임 실제로 굽는 평면에 놓입니다. 6-2. Text to Motion — 테이크 테이크 는 한 번의 생성 단위입니다. 각자 프롬프트·길이·시드·대상 리그·경로 커브를 가집니다. 테이크가 없으면 "Start here" 안내가 나옵니다. 컨트롤 설명 + / - 테이크 추가·삭제. 새 테이크는 앞 테이크의 프롬프트와 길이를 복사합니다 Use Take 생성해 둔 테이크를 그 리그에 다시 올립니다 Prompt / Preset 동작 설명. Preset에서 예시 문장을 고를 수 있습니다 Source Rig 이 테이크가 들어갈 리그. (active source) 면 활성 리그 Duration / Seed 길이(초) / -1 이면 매번 다르게, 숫자를 넣으면 같은 결과 Include in Generate All 끄면 Generate All에서 빠집니다 Continue from the take above 위 테이크의 끝 동작에서 이어서 만듭니다 Create Curve / Disconnect Curve 이 테이크 전용 경로(NURBS 커브)를 만들거나 연결을 끊습니다. 커브가 있으면 웨이포인트 대신 커브를 따라 걷습니다 (Face Waypoint Direction이 켜져 있으면 커브 방향을 바라봄) Reduce Foot Skating 발 미끄러짐 보정 (꺼져 있으면 웨이포인트·포즈키가 대략적으로만 맞는다고 경고) Denoising Steps / Prompt Strength / Constraint Strength 생성 품질과 조건을 따르는 강도 Generate Take / Generate All (n) 선택한 테이크 / 켜져 있는 모든 테이크. 생성 중에는 Generate All 버튼이 Stop 이 됩니다 Stream to Unreal / Stream Port 만든 테이크를 언리얼로 실시간 전송 (6-3 참고) 웨이포인트 — "이 프레임에 여기를 지나가라" Follow Waypoints 를 켭니다. 타임라인을 원하는 프레임에 두고 + 를 누르면 MF_Waypoint_01 로케이터가 생깁니다 (선택한 물체 위치 또는 원점, 리그가 바라보는 방향으로). 목록에서 고르고 Frame / Enabled 로 프레임과 사용 여부를 고칠 수 있습니다. Retarget — 내 캐릭터에 옮기기 Source Rig — 비워 두면 가장 최근에 테이크를 넣은 리그. 목록에서 다른 MotionForge 리그를 고를 수 있습니다. 라이브 테이크가 Bake 전이면 먼저 Bake하고, 키가 없는 리그는 현재 자세를 옮깁니다. MMD 모델 은 양방향으로 쓸 수 있습니다( maya_mmd_tools 설치 필요). 이 패널 맨 위 MMD 상자에 Import MMD Model (PMX) 와 Import MMD Motion (VMD) 버튼이 있고, 가져온 모델은 이 목록에 MMD: <이름> 으로 나타나며 키는 테이크와 같은 방식으로 복사됩니다. 테이크를 MMD 모델에 입히려면 Rig Type 을 MMD model 로 두세요(Auto-Detect도 찾아 줍니다). 뼈는 MMD 이름으로 읽으므로 팔을 upperarm_L 이라 부르는 모델도 left_arm 이라 부르는 모델도 똑같이 동작합니다. 몸통과 팔다리가 매핑되며, 손가락과 비틀림 본은 아직 매핑되지 않습니다. 받을 캐릭터의 조인트(또는 몸 메쉬)를 선택하고 Set Selected (또는 Target Rig에 이름). 네임스페이스가 붙은 참조 캐릭터 ( Hero:Hips )도 그대로 됩니다. 가져온 툴이 골격을 몸 메쉬 아래에 나눠 둔 경우(MetaHuman Builder의 MMB_bodyShapeBof4|spine_04 )에는 메쉬로 등록되고, 그 아래 모든 조인트가 리타겟됩니다. 몸 골격 옆에 같은 이름의 골격이 하나 더 있는 캐릭터(메타휴먼 헤드 리그)는 몸 골격을 구동하고 그 복제 골격이 이를 따라갑니다. 라이브·Bake 모두 그렇습니다. Rig Type 은 보통 자동 감지. 마야 애니메이터가 실제로 쓰는 컨트롤 리그 두 가지가 목록에 있습니다: HumanIK Control Rig 와 mGear EPIC 바이패드 . 테이크는 그 컨트롤에 키로 들어가고(골반과 다리는 HumanIK 이펙터로 — 이 솔버가 읽는 것은 그 채널입니다), 캐릭터는 컨트롤을 따라 움직입니다. Method — MotionForge (관절별 복사) / HumanIK (Maya) (두 리그를 HumanIK 캐릭터로 정의하고 Maya HumanIK로 구동 후 베이크). Retarget to Character . 옵션 설명 Auto-Align Rest Pose 팔다리 기본 자세가 달라도 맞춰서 옮깁니다 Auto Scale Motion 키가 다르면 이동 거리를 비율로 맞춥니다 Match Floor Contact 매 프레임 발이 바닥에 닿도록 높이를 맞춥니다 Legs on IK (아래 Share With Characters 상자의 체크박스) 발을 소스의 발 위치(캐릭터 자신의 골반 기준, 다리 길이 비율로)에 놓고 무릎을 2관절 IK로 풉니다. 체형이 달라도 발이 미끄러지지 않습니다. Retarget to Character 에도 함께 적용됩니다 Share With Characters — 한 테이크를 여러 캐릭터에 자동으로 + — 선택한 캐릭터로 행을 추가합니다. 행마다 Source (비우면 활성 리그) · Character · Rig Type · Enabled . Fill Characters After Generating 이 켜져 있으면 Generate·Bake 직후 자동으로 채웁니다. Fill Characters 는 지금 바로. 라이브(ARDY·MotionBricks) 중에는 캐릭터가 자세로 따라옵니다. 같은 캐릭터의 두 번째 골격(메타휴먼 헤드 리그)도 함께 따라갑니다. Reset All (Live Path·Kimodo·MotionBricks)은 이 캐릭터들도 함께 리셋합니다. 키를 지우고 캐릭터 자신의 쉬는 자세 — 마야의 바인드 포즈 (Go to Bind Pose가 되돌리는 그 자세)로 돌아갑니다. 메타휴먼 바디는 바인드 당시의 자세 전체(루트에 -90)로 돌아가며, 회전 채널을 0으로 미는 방식이 아니므로 넘어져 바닥 아래로 내려가지 않습니다. 이 자세는 캐릭터가 지금 서 있는 모습이 아니라 골격에 기록된 바인드 포즈 에서 읽습니다. 라이브 실행은 팔로워의 본을 키 없이 세팅하므로, 중간에 멈춘 캐릭터는 애니메이션이 전혀 없는 것처럼 보이는데, 그 자세를 쉬는 자세로 기억해서 리셋이 테이크가 가 있던 곳으로 걸어가 버렸습니다. 바인드 포즈가 아예 없는 골격(MotionForge가 만들고 스킨하지 않은 리그)은 처음 봤을 때의 자세로, MotionForge가 보기 전에 이미 키가 있던 캐릭터는 테이크가 시작하는 지점으로 돌아갑니다. 행과 Target Rig는 씬에 저장되므로, 이전 세션에서 채워 둔 캐릭터도 되돌아갑니다. Cascadeur 연동 7-1. 설치 (한 번만) 창의 Install Cascadeur Plug-in (또는 메뉴) — installer\integrations\cascadeur\install_mf_maya.bat 을 실행합니다. 관리자 권한을 물으면 허용하세요. 마야 전용 파일 2개( mf_maya_link.py , mf_maya_apply.py )를 Cascadeur에 복사합니다. Blender 애드온의 Cascadeur 플러그인과 파일 이름도 포트도 겹치지 않습니다. 둘을 같이 설치하고 동시에 켜도 됩니다. Cascadeur를 다시 시작합니다. Cascadeur의 Animation Scripts > MotionForge Maya Link 를 실행합니다 (포트 9574). 보낼 대상은 선택한 골격 입니다. MotionForge 리그뿐 아니라 내 캐릭터의 조인트를 골라도 됩니다. 아무것도 고르지 않으면 가장 최근에 테이크를 넣은 리그입니다. 7-2. 보내기 컨트롤 설명 Send Keyframes Only (Cascadeur에 이미 있는 캐릭터에 키만) / Character and Bones (캐릭터 자체를 FBX로) With Mesh / With Animation 캐릭터를 보낼 때 몸 메쉬·애니메이션 포함 여부 (애니메이션을 끄면 쉬는 자세로 보냄) Unify Skeleton 메쉬가 스킨된 관절이 여러 계층에 흩어져 있거나 컨트롤 리그(컨스트레인트·IK·HumanIK)로 움직이면, 스킨 관절만으로 하나의 골격 복사본 을 만들고 동작을 베이크해서 보냅니다. 내 씬은 그대로입니다 Fill Rig Mode (체크) 캐릭터가 Cascadeur에 다 열리면 Quick Rigging Tool을 이 리그의 관절로 자동으로 채웁니다 Rig Type (Keyframes Only) 뼈 이름 체계. 아래에 "N bones matched" 또는 이유가 나옵니다 Send Frame Range / Current Frame 재생 범위 전체 / 지금 프레임 Status Cascadeur가 받은 프레임 수 Fill Rig Mode (버튼) 이미 보낸 캐릭터에 Rig Mode를 지금 채웁니다 순서가 중요합니다 : Cascadeur에 캐릭터가 없다면 먼저 Character and Bones 로 보내고, 그다음 키·Live·받아오기를 쓰세요. 보낼 때 Cascadeur가 기록한 도착 자세를 리그에 저장해 두므로, Cascadeur나 Maya를 재시작해도 받아오기가 맞습니다. 7-3. 실시간 미러 (Live) Check the Link — 링크를 한 단계씩 시험해서 어디서 막히는지 보고합니다 (Script Editor에 전체). Mirror — Follow the Focus (작업 중인 창 쪽이 보냄) / Maya to Cascadeur / Cascadeur to Maya . Bones — Mapped Bones / Whole Skeleton . Live: Mirror This Rig — 다시 누르거나 Esc 로 멈춥니다. 재생하면 프레임마다 Cascadeur에도 키가 들어갑니다. 7-4. 받아오기 (From Cascadeur) 컨트롤 설명 Receive Animation Only (선택한 골격에 키만) / Mesh + Animation (Cascadeur가 FBX로 내보내고 Maya가 새 오브젝트로 가져옴) Whole Take Cascadeur의 모든 프레임. 끄면 씬 재생 범위만 Timing Match Timing (보낸 속도 그대로 — Cascadeur fps 차이를 되돌림) / Fit Scene Range (씬 범위에 맞춰 늘이고 줄임) / One For One (프레임 그대로) Receive from Cascadeur 가져오기 8. Maya에서 알아두면 좋은 동작 상황 MotionForge의 동작 씬 단위가 cm가 아님 (m, inch 등) 그대로 정확하게 동작합니다. 작업하는 동안만 cm로 계산하고 씬 단위는 원래대로 돌려 놓습니다 실행 취소 리그 만들기 · 테이크 키 넣기 · Bake · 리타겟 · 받아오기는 각각 Ctrl+Z 한 번 으로 되돌아갑니다 씬 fps 빈 씬이면 테이크 속도로 맞춥니다 (ARDY 20 · Kimodo/MotionBricks 30). 다른 애니메이션이 이미 있으면 씬 fps는 그대로 두고 , 테이크를 실제 시간에 맞춰 키를 넣습니다 재생이 너무 빠름 재생 모드가 "Play every frame"이면 자동으로 Real-time으로 바꿉니다 같은 리그에 다시 생성 이전 테이크의 키를 지우고 새로 넣습니다 회전이 180°를 넘음 오일러 필터가 자동으로 적용됩니다 씬 저장 후 다시 열기 / Maya 재시작 리그와 함께 창의 모든 설정·목록이 돌아옵니다 ( motionforgeState 노드). 조인트 이름을 바꿔도 찾습니다 리그를 그룹에 넣고 옮김 모션은 리그 자신의 공간에서 움직입니다. 그룹을 옮기거나 돌리면 테이크도, 웨이포인트·목표도 함께 따라갑니다 다른 곳에서 가져온 골격 (관절 방향이 제각각) Add Selected로 넣으면 각 관절의 기본 방향을 기억해서 정확히 키를 넣습니다 씬에 같은 이름의 노드가 있음 겹치지 않는 이름으로 리그를 만듭니다 임시 파일 7일 지난 생성·전송 파일은 플러그인을 켤 때 자동으로 지워집니다 (Use Take는 그 안에서만 가능) 9. Reload — Maya 재시작 없이 업데이트 MotionForge > Reload MotionForge (셸프 Reload ) 새 코드를 바로 반영합니다. 실행 중이던 Live, MotionBricks 라이브, Cascadeur 미러는 먼저 멈추고, ARDY 연결은 끊깁니다. 리그·테이크·웨이포인트·포즈키·라이브 목록·Kimodo/MotionBricks 캐릭터·Share 목록·설정은 그대로 남습니다. Reload 후 창을 다시 여세요. 10. Blender와 다른 점 이식되지 않은 기능은 없습니다. 창의 모든 버튼이 동작합니다. 다만 Maya에 맞게 바뀐 부분이 있습니다. Blender Maya 3D 커서 (Shift+우클릭) MF_MB_Cursor 로케이터 + Cursor Tool (바닥 클릭) Rigify 팔다리 IK 구동 (Legs on IK) 캐릭터 자신의 다리에서 푸는 2관절 IK. 추가로 HumanIK 리타겟 방식 제공 Rigify 3중 골격 합치기 (Unify Skeleton) 스킨 관절만으로 하나의 골격 복사본을 만들고 컨트롤 리그 동작을 베이크 포즈키 IK 본 Maya ikHandle + 폴 벡터 로케이터 경로 커브 (Bezier) NURBS 커브 BVH 가져오기 (Blender 내장) MotionForge 자체 BVH 리더 Rigify 컨트롤 리그 mGear EPIC 바이패드 (mGear 설치 시) 또는 HumanIK Control Rig 엔진 설치 (애드온에 다운로드 목록 포함) 이 저장소에는 다운로드 목록이 없습니다. Blender 애드온으로 설치한 엔진 폴더를 그대로 지정하세요 11. 문제 해결 메시지 / 증상 해결 ARDY is not installed under the Engine Folder Set Engine Folder... 로 엔진 폴더를 지정하고 Engine Status 로 확인하세요 Create a rig first / 리그가 없다는 메시지 Create Rig (또는 각 패널의 + )로 리그를 만드세요 The take has N joints but the rig has M 다른 모델로 만든 리그입니다. Create Rig 를 다시 누르세요 Live 상태가 engine off - press Connect ARDY first Connect ARDY 를 먼저 누르세요 Cascadeur is not listening on ... Cascadeur에서 MotionForge Maya Link 를 실행하세요 This Cascadeur's plugin has no ... (404) Cascadeur 쪽 파일이 오래됐습니다. install_mf_maya.bat 을 다시 실행하고 Cascadeur를 재시작하세요 연결 후 stale (Cascadeur 링크 버전이 다름) install_mf_maya.bat 을 다시 실행하고 Cascadeur를 재시작하세요 생성이 오래 걸림 창의 생성은 백그라운드로 돕니다. 첫 프롬프트는 오래 걸립니다. 상태 줄과 Script Editor에서 진행 상황을 확인하세요 (메뉴의 원클릭 생성은 끝날 때까지 기다립니다) Reload 후 창이 비어 있음 Open MotionForge Window 로 창을 다시 여세요 12. 라이선스 MotionForge for Maya는 참이슬 라이선스 로 판매되며, 구매자 1인당 라이선스 1개입니다. 복제·수정·배포·재배포·재판매는 허용되지 않으며, 제공된 파일 그대로만 사용해야 합니다. 전문은 설치한 폴더의 LICENSE.txt 에 있습니다. 제3자 구성 요소(NVIDIA 모델·소스, ggml)는 각자의 라이선스를 그대로 따르며 수정하지 않습니다: licenses\ 및 scripts\motionforge\core\installer\*\licenses\ 참조. Blender 애드온의 라이선스는 이 제품에 적용되지 않습니다.

docs.text: 텍스트 한 줄로 캐릭터 모션을 만들고, 내 캐릭터에 옮기고, Cascadeur로 보내는 Maya 플러그인입니다. Blender 애드온 MotionForge v0.5.0을 Maya 2027로 이식했습니다. 모든 엔진은 내 컴퓨터에서 돌아가며 인터넷으로 아무것도 보내지 않습니다. English: index.md

docs.text: 0.1.0에서 올라오는 경우: 0.2.0을 설치한 뒤 MotionForge 창에서 Install Engines 를 한 번 눌러 주세요. 엔진 폴더의 MotionBricks 런타임을 새 것으로 바꾸고, 사람(SOMA Human)이 쓰는 모델과 스타일도 받습니다. 옆의 Check for Updates 는 내려받지 않고 무엇이 새로운지 알려 줍니다.
docs.title: 0.2.0 새 기능

docs.text: MotionBricks에 사람이 들어옴 - MotionBricks 패널의 + 를 누르면 SOMA Human 과 Unitree G1 Robot 중에서 고릅니다. 사람도 로봇과 같은 Style, Go, Speed, Generate Motion , Bake , Live , Retarget을 씁니다. - 사람의 스타일 14개(idle, walk, slow walk, jog, run, injured, stealth, scared, zombie, happy, boxing, gun, 팔꿈치·손 기기)는 Install Engines 가 함께 설치합니다. 빠진 것이 있으면 Styles 상자의 Make Missing 이 Kimodo로 만들고, Save as Style 은 구운(Bake) 또는 생성한 테이크를 내 스타일로 저장합니다. - Install Engines 가 사람용 모델(380 MB)을 NVIDIA 라이선스와 함께 받습니다. 별도의 mayapy에서 CPU로 돌기 때문에 GPU가 필요 없습니다. 사람과 로봇 모두 테이크 - 캐릭터마다 테이크 목록( + Take / - Take / Show Take )이 있습니다. 테이크는 자기 스타일, 방향 또는 타겟, 속도, 시드, 길이를 갖고 씬과 함께 저장됩니다. - 테이크는 하나의 타임라인에 차례로 이어지고(예: 1-30, 31-90, 91-135프레임), Generate Motion 은 체크된 테이크를 앞 테이크가 끝난 자리에서 이어서 만듭니다. Bake 는 하나의 애니메이션으로 기록합니다. 포즈 투 포즈 - 사람의 테이크에서 End on Pose Key 를 켭니다. 캐릭터를 옮기고 돌리고 포즈를 잡아 도착할 프레임(예: 50, 100)에 키를 넣으면, 각 테이크는 자기 키까지 시작한 포즈에서 만들어집니다. 키 간격은 30fps 기준 19~59프레임입니다. - Poses to Use (1~4)와 Transition Early By 로 멈추지 않고 여러 포즈를 지나며 움직입니다. Arrive in a Clip Pose 는 스타일 클립의 한 포즈에서 끝나는 테이크를 만듭니다. MMD 캐릭터 양방향 - maya_mmd_tools 를 설치하면 Retarget 패널에 MMD 상자가 생깁니다: Import MMD Model (PMX) , Import MMD Motion (VMD) . - 불러온 모델은 소스 (목록에 MMD: <이름> , VMD 키를 다른 테이크처럼 옮김)로도, 타겟 ( Rig Type 을 MMD model 로, Auto-Detect로도 찾음)으로도 쓸 수 있습니다. 본은 MMD 이름으로 읽어서 upperarm_L 이든 left_arm 이든 똑같이 동작합니다. - 굽기 동안 다리를 FK로 바꿔서 다리 IK가 다리를 붙잡지 않습니다. 첫 프레임부터 무릎이 키대로 서 있고, 스킨이 묶인 D본 다리가 함께 움직이며, IK 컨트롤러도 발을 따라갑니다. Reset All 은 IK를 다시 켭니다. 팔·팔꿈치·손·목 솔버는 건드리지 않습니다.

docs.text: Install Engines 가 업데이트도 합니다. 공개된 런타임과 다른 파일은 교체되어, 예전 설치에도 새 Kimodo·ARDY·MotionBricks 런타임이 반영됩니다. 직접 만들거나 고친 스타일은 덮어쓰지 않습니다. 사람 모델과 ONNX Runtime은 Blender 애드온 설치와 공유되므로 엔진 폴더 하나로 둘 다 씁니다. 설치 안내에 폴더 구성을 정확히 적었습니다: 압축을 푼 Maya_MotionForge-<버전> 폴더 이름을 MotionForge 로 바꿔서, MAYA_MODULE_PATH 에 넣은 폴더 바로 안에 MotionForge.mod 가 있게 합니다.
docs.title: 바뀐 점

docs.text: MMD 타겟의 다리. 다리 IK가 다리를 붙잡고, 기본 자세에서도 무릎을 굽혀 첫 프레임부터 접혀 있었으며, 스킨이 묶인 D본 다리가 멈춘 솔버를 읽어 FK가 움직여도 몸이 뻣뻣했습니다. 그룹으로 등록한 MMD 모델(Set Selected가 만드는 것)을 MMD 모델로 인식합니다. Live Path 목록의 테이크마다 길이가 따로 있습니다.
